newsitem.title: UK: British MP seeks "bull bar" ban.
newsitem.headline: British MP seeks "bull bar" ban.

text.p: A British legislator got backing from fellow MPs on Tuesday for an attempt to ban "bull bars" on road vehicles.

Labour's Paul Flynn was given permission to bring in a bill to outlaw the devices without any opposition. However, because of lack of parliamentary time, the bill has no chance of making further progress.
Flynn described the bull bar as "an extremely dangerous fashion accessory which has no useful purpose" and said people were incurring unnecessary injuries in road accidents involving them.
He said there were already moves in the European Union to outlaw bull bars on new vehicles but Britain should go further by forcing owners of existing vehicles with them on to remove them.
